part.name: Enclosed roller-dispenser housing with cradle, side straps, and power cord
part.description: A rounded-rectangle enclosure with a top access opening and internal cylindrical roll interface, supported/retained by an external U-shaped cradle and two side mounting straps. Includes small bottom connector/feet features and an attached power cord with plug.
part.symmetry_note: Largely symmetric about the mid-plane X=0 (left/right), with mirrored side straps and rounded end geometry; asymmetry introduced by cord exit and internal cutouts.

Section.name: Main outer housing shell
features included: Top rounded edge bands (corner fillet cylinders)
Lower outer curvature (large BSPLINE underside surface)
Section.function intent: Provide primary protective enclosure and structure for internal mechanism; offer external mounting datum surfaces and resist bending/torsion from mounted loads.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a stiff shell beam: distributes strap/cradle reaction loads into the larger shell area; rounded corners reduce stress concentration; underside curvature improves stiffness and clearance.
Section.geometry: Long prismatic shell with large-radius corner rounds along the length (Y axis), planar side faces at X=±101.6, planar end faces at Y=0 and Y=355.6, and a broad BSPLINE curved underside from Z=-127 to Z=0.
Section.location: Largest gray body spanning the full part length; surrounds all other sections.

Section.name: Top access opening & internal cavity walls
features included: Local cylindrical cutout/port in internal region
Section.function intent: Provide access for loading/servicing internal roll/mechanism and define the internal envelope that guides/locates inserted components.
Section.physical behavior: Cavity walls act as locating datums and reaction surfaces; rim edges resist local deformation and provide stiffness around the large cutout.
Section.geometry: Rectangular cutout and stepped internal bay; multiple planar faces forming inner walls and ledges; local cylindrical surface used as a port/relief in the cavity region.
Section.location: Upper region of housing (visible from top and isometric), within the shell near the middle length.

Section.name: Internal roll / drum interface
features included: Top/bottom end faces of roll cavity
Section.function intent: Provide the primary cylindrical interface that supports or represents a roll/drum (e.g., dispenser roll), allowing rotation and controlled unwinding/feeding.
Section.physical behavior: Cylindrical surface acts as a bearing/support envelope; end planes act as axial stops/positioners; large radius improves load distribution and reduces local contact stress.
Section.geometry: Dominant cylinder along Y with large radius (~69.85) plus associated end planes; additional nearby cylinder (R~68.58) and cap planes define a nested/stepped drum shape.
Section.location: Visible through the top opening, centered in the housing cavity.

Section.name: External U-shaped cradle / lower support band
Section.function intent: Provide an external structural cradle to support the housing, distribute load into mounting points, and protect/lift the underside; likely forms the primary mount/stand interface.
Section.physical behavior: Works as a curved beam (hoop-like) that spreads loads around the lower perimeter; resists bending by arch action; provides stable support contact and mounting reaction paths.
Section.geometry: Broad U-shaped curved surface set wrapping around the lower housing with planar side faces at X=±126.999 and a large BSPLINE surface spanning Z negative to near zero; includes local cylindrical boss/holes for fasteners or pins.
Section.location: Black U-shaped component seen in front/back views wrapping around bottom of housing.

Section.name: Side mounting straps (left & right)
Section.function intent: Provide mounting/attachment points to external structure (wall/stand), allowing the unit to be hung or bolted; strap holes constrain translation and rotation.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as tension/bending members: straps carry load from housing/cradle into screw/bolt; holes concentrate stress—local cone/cylinder geometry indicates countersink/counterbore to seat fasteners.
Section.geometry: Thin bracket arms (not fully enumerated here due to many small faces) with cylindrical through-holes and conical countersinks; mirrored on left/right about X=0.
Section.location: Black vertical straps visible on left and right side views, with round hole near upper end.

Section.name: Bottom connectors / feet blocks (pair)
features included: Edge fillets/chamfers (implicit in many small faces)
Section.function intent: Provide small support standoffs and/or connector housings at the bottom region; likely serves as feet or interface pads and may locate cable/strain relief features.
Section.physical behavior: Transfers local compressive loads to a support surface; protects housing from direct ground contact; small blocks can also constrain cable path and reduce bending at exit.
Section.geometry: Two small prismatic blocks with multiple planar faces and several small cylindrical holes/features; located near lower end region.
Section.location: Bottom of assembly near the cord exit side; seen as two small rectangular pads/blocks in bottom view/front view.

Section.name: Power cord and plug
Section.function intent: Provide electrical power connection to the unit; cord routing allows flexible positioning; plug provides standardized interface to mains supply.
Section.physical behavior: Cord acts as flexible member resisting bending with jacket compliance; strain-relief reduces curvature/peak stress at exit; plug body is rigid and protects terminations.
Section.geometry: Long slender cable represented by multiple BSPLINE surfaces and planar end features; plug body has small planar facets and chamfer-like planes.
Section.location: Exits from bottom/side region and extends outward; visible in front/back/left/right/bottom views.
